thread:
Maria: Quick ask — we need a compact 'benchpack' for next week's webinar (Apr 7). One hero infographic, 3 social tiles (X, LinkedIn, email header), and a single-slide benchmark diagram. Can design team take?
Ashton: On it. Can you confirm final metrics we want to visualize and any must-have callouts?
Maria: Key metrics: 95th p99 latency 120ms, inference cost per 1k tokens $0.09, throughput 120 reqs/s with Dedicated. Callouts: 'Unified runtime' + 'predictable economics'. Keep copy short.
Jordan: Also include CTA: 'Register: link' + UTM params: utm_source=webinar&utm_campaign=benchpack_apr7. We need separate social copy variants.
Ashton: Got the metrics. Any brand constraints / color palette?
Ken: Use core palette only (redwood core + charcoal). No drop shadows on hero. Font: Inter var. Also avoid superlative claims ('fastest') without legal ok.
Legal: We need to avoid 'fastest' or 'lowest cost' absolute claims. Suggested alt: 'industry-leading' w/ substantiation doc linked: https://legal/redwood/claims.pdf
Emily: FYI — inbound lead routing: set webinar source to 'webinar-bench-apr7' and map to SDR queue 'bench-webinar-APR'. Add form hidden field 'bench_variant'.
Ashton: timeline? I can do first comps by EOD Wed. Need final copy and hero image assets by Tue morning.
Maria: I'll push copy variants today. + add hero data CSV.
Maria: Copy variants: 
```
Variant A: Ship LLM features with predictable cost and latency. Join our webinar Apr 7. Register: https://redwood.ai/webinar?utm_campaign=benchpack_apr7
Variant B: Reduce inference costs without sacrificing output. See how — Apr 7 webinar.
Variant C: Make LLM inference predictable at scale. Live demo + benchmarks.
```
Ashton: Perfect. For hero diagram, request raw traces or simplified numbers — CSV upload link?
Maria: uploaded to Figma + GDrive: https://figma.com/file/abc123 and https://drive.redwood/bench/apr7.csv
Design-bot: New figma comment on page 'Hero' by Ashton: 'draft1' https://figma.com/file/abc123?node-id=42
Ashton: Posting accessibility checklist: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for text over background, alt text for social tiles.
Ken: Approve color & typography. Send final comps to me for brand sweep before assets go to localization.
Jordan: Let's also produce a 1-slide 'single metric' variant for sales enablement. Can we get an editable PPTX?
Ashton: Will export to PPTX + PNGs.
Maria: Thanks team — I'll coordinate approvals. @Ken @Legal please review hero copy by end of day. :thumbsup:
Ken: Will review by 4pm.
Legal: Will check claims; if we need data substantiation we'll loop in Research.
Maria: Closing note: launch social posts scheduled Apr 8 9am PT. Ashton drop final files into the 'marketing-assets' folder once approved. Thanks!
